CustomField.description: Currently set to the first Monday after the createdDate
CustomField.formula: DATETIMEVALUE( TEXT( YEAR( Booking_Form__r.Date_of_Performance__c + CASE( MOD(Booking_Form__r.Date_of_Performance__c - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7), 0, 1, /* If Monday, add 1 day */ 1, 6, /* If Tuesday, add 6 days */ 2, 5, /* If Wednesday, add 5 days */ 3, 4, /* If Thursday, add 4 days */ 4, 3, /* If Friday, add 3 days */ 5, 2, /* If Saturday, add 2 days */ 6, 1, /* If Sunday, add 1 day */ 0 /* Default value */ ) ) ) & "-" & TEXT( MONTH( Booking_Form__r.Date_of_Performance__c + CASE( MOD(Booking_Form__r.Date_of_Performance__c - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7), 0, 1, 1, 6, 2, 5, 3, 4, 4, 3, 5, 2, 6, 1, 0 ) ) ) & "-" & TEXT( DAY( Booking_Form__r.Date_of_Performance__c + CASE( MOD(Booking_Form__r.Date_of_Performance__c - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7), 0, 1, 1, 6, 2, 5, 3, 4, 4, 3, 5, 2, 6, 1, 0 ) ) ) & " " & "08:00:00" )
CustomField.label: Send Date
